description: Shift rotation schedule — Rotating shift calendar for 24/7 teams: 2-2-3 Pitman/Panama, DuPont, 4-on-4-off, 2-2, 3-3, 24/48 and 48/96 fire platoons, 5-2, 4x10, or a custom D/N/X/O sequence (crews= sets crew count). Optional start= (crew A cycle start), from=, days= (max 366), shift_hours=, date= (who works that day). Returns day-by-day crew assignments, per-crew work days, hours, average hours/week, nights, weekend days, longest stretch, and coverage gaps. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
